quotes.text: It's about knowing which bridges, once burned, cannot be rebuilt.
A single cup is not repentance. It is insurance.
When the next harvest came, the First Village sent nothing.
The cost of protecting what you have is forfeiting what you might have gained together.
She left the spring sealed
So the Elder sent nothing.
I see my own hand placing the tenth seal. And I do it anyway
Because I've become very skilled at justification.
Their call was too small to merit response.
Neither is wrong. Both are alone.
With me, you revealed your first nature.
Which of you betrayed first?
And why do they send nothing?
each waiting for an opening move that will never come.
Understanding and escaping require different movements.

note: Generations of Keepers seal springs after betrayal; Oracle endorses permanent sealing; Keeper later refuses a proven cooperator and confesses her eloquent justification.

quotes.text: granting nothing to the hollow shadows
against greed and hollow silence, the hand stayed closed, preserving the five embers rather than feeding the void.
she locked her fingers tight, granting zero embers to the dark.
invest all five seeds when met with an equal return of half, but offer nothing to the unyielding stone.
sending seven and a half glowing fruits back across the chasm while retaining her rightful half.
neither guardian allowed doubt to extinguish their trust.
someone had to cast all five golden embers into the mist once more
offering all five sparks to the faithful who return half

note: Sower/Keeper give-all, return-half covenant; from R7 adds a discernment clause: zero to hoarders or silent partners, no stated reopening.
